intro.title: Caching Strategies
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple simulation of a web server that uses different caching strategies to improve performance. You will learn the core concept of caching, which stores frequently accessed data to reduce load times and server requests. The main constructs involved are cache policies like Cache-Aside, Write-Through, and Write-Back, implemented using basic data structures. By the end, you will understand how to choose and apply these strategies in system design to optimize data retrieval and manage updates efficiently.
intro.usecase: Caching strategies are fundamental to building responsive systems that users interact with daily. When you browse an e-commerce site and product images load instantly, or when you search on a social media platform and see recent results without delay, you're experiencing caching in action. As a developer, you'll implement these strategies to optimize dashboards that display real-time analytics, shopping carts that remember items between sessions, and content feeds that load smoothly as users scroll. Mastering caching ensures your applications remain fast and reliable under real-world traffic conditions.
